body.statement: If all fields \(H_p(u)\) are simultaneously diagonal in one fixed orthonormal basis for every \(p\in\mathcal A\) and \(u\in\Omega\), then every \(C_{q\leftarrow p}\) is cyclically monotone and \(\gamma_{pq}=\inf_{u\in\Omega}\lambda_{\min}(H_q(u)H_p(u)^{-1})>0\).
body.justification: The reduction recovers ordinary scalar quantile rank preservation and a transparent multivariate commuting subclass.
body.gap: CarlierChernozhukovGalichon2016VQR recovers scalar conditional quantiles, but the commuting reduction checks that the new cross-Hessian notation collapses to that known benchmark.
body.consumer: Researchers can verify that the frontier does not alter classical scalar changes-in-changes or separable vector-quantile mechanisms.
